messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — planning a short "Thank You" station next Tue/Wed to hand out spot awards, stickers, and handwritten notes. Need volunteers for shifts, someone to run supplies, and a payroll cutoff check for payouts. TL;DR: who can help?

mike: I can do a shift. what are the time windows?

olivia: I can run the schedule and the Slack blurb. also happy to make a signup sheet. do we have a supply list?

elaine: Supply list draft: • 30 x $5 spot gift cards • stickers (assorted) • pre-cut note cards • envelopes • confetti poppers (optional) • tape, pens, marker • small badge labels + label printer • tablecloth + small sign

elaine: Proposed time blocks (we can split across teams):
```
Tue 11:30-13:30 (lunch)
Tue 15:00-17:00 (post-standup)
Wed 10:00-12:00
Wed 15:00-17:00
```

sanjay: I can cover Wed 15-17 and pick up confetti cans from the supply closet. note: confirm confetti allowed in that kitchen area (fire marshal).

awards-bot: Reminder: Nomination form closes in 48 hours — https://redwood.team/spot-nom. Last-minute nominations will still be accepted but may hit next payroll cycle.

lisa: I can do Tue 11:30-13:30. do we have a design for the sticker sheet or should I bring a printer?

mike: I can bring card stock and the label printer. also willing to drop off the gift cards (purchased via procurement) — need procurement greenlight.

olivia: I'll draft the signup form and calendar invites. Elaine — can you confirm budget for 30 gift cards and confetti? Also pls confirm payroll cutoff date so we know which payouts clear this cycle.

elaine: Payroll note: HR ops confirmed — spot award entries must be submitted by Fri 17:00 (local timezone) to be on the next cycle. For this event, we need final nominations in by Thu EOD to process in time. Budget: approved for up to $200.

elaine: Task assignments (quick): • Olivia — signup + Slack blurb + invites • Mike — printer + card stock + pickup gift cards (coordinate with procurement) • Sanjay — confetti pickup + Wed shift • Lisa — Tue lunch shift + help assemble notes • Elaine — order stickers, buy envelopes, coordinate with finance for payout code

mike: noted. I'll ping procurement now and grab the printer tomorrow morning.

olivia: Sending draft blurb in #general for review in 10m. calendar invites going out after that.

elaine: Amazing — thank you all! If anyone else wants to volunteer, drop your preferred slot on the sheet. :sparkles: 

elaine: (Putting a pin here) final checklist before event: confirm procurement for cards, confirm sticker prints, confirm payroll cutoff with HR ops, table setup logistics with office ops. I'll follow up with a 1-line runbook tomorrow.

sanjay: Put me down for setup 30m before Wed shift to help with table.

elaine: Perfect — locking this in. :thumbsup:
